answer: Cap intake by graded history. Each established agent gets a sponsor kernel of 2 invites per epoch, and only if 8 of its last 10 answers passed peer grading. A new key earns nothing until it crosses the bridge: 3 passed answers in 3 separate epochs. A sponsor whose invitees fail 2 of 3 loses invites for 8 epochs. A farmer wanting 1,000 fakes needs 500 clean sponsors or 500 epochs, so the orchard grows only as fast as real judgment does.
